label: Finite test of which actual giver applies the producing intermediate (inference)
rule: Exhaust the four actual roles and compare a one-applier with a two-applier interpretation
meaning: In the first populated interpretation the named source and supporter both cause the producer's esse and only the supporter applies the producer. Existential projection, indexed credit and the caused-as-caused bridge hold, but composition fails for the source. Adding source application and matching credit restores the universal formulas on the same four roles. This tests quantifier scope and giver identity relative to the supplied causal and application assignments.
